نحرنشف (form IIIq)
# نَحْرَنْشِفُ (naḥranšifu) /naħ.ran.ʃi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
# نَحْرَنْشِفَ (naḥranšifa) /naħ.ran.ʃi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
# نَحْرَنْشِفْ (naḥranšif) /naħ.ran.ʃif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
